---
title: "Numbering hook: custom hook"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(officequarto)
## custom figure hook: the default behaviour, then a note paragraph after the figure
oq_numbering(
  fig_hook = function(res, options) {
    paste0(oq_fig_hook()(res, options), "\n\nCUSTOM-NOTE for ", options$label, "\n\n")
  }
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-c
#| fig-cap: "FIG-C-CAP"
#| echo: false
plot(1:5)
```

Siehe `r oq_ref("fig-c")`.
